messages:
Anya (PM): Quick sync — had a follow-up with Acme. they said SSO + tenant routing is a must for their pilot. That's a pretty heavy ask for MVP. We need to decide cuts vs timeline shift. Proposal: keep core MVP, move full SSO to v1, ship basic tenant routing and an invite workaround for pilot. thoughts?
Mike (Eng Lead): SSO (SAML/OIDC) is non-trivial — cert rotation, metadata, edge cases. full SSO in MVP risks scope creep. :grimacing:
Kartik (Infra): From infra side, tenant routing + basic admin token flow is doable within current infra constraints. Full SAML adds 2 infra weeks for mapping + cert infra.
Sarah (Research): Note — Acme explicitly said SAML SSO required for security review. they said without it they won't pilot. but they might accept an invite-only pilot if we document the workaround.
Jill (UX): Invite flow is straightforward UX-wise, but onboarding copy + admin console surfaces need updates. estimate 2 sprints of design + 1 for polish.
Anya (PM): Option A: delay launch 2 weeks to include full SSO. Option B: cut full SSO to v1 and offer invite-only pilot for Acme. Option C: implement minimal SSO (email-based invites + admin console) as a stopgap. lean rec?
Mike (Eng Lead): A is dangerous — downstream customers expect timeline. B is my vote. C ok if Legal signs off and Sales owns expectation.
Sales: If we offer invite pilot, we need a written ack: NDA/MSA + scope doc. Acme will likely accept if we call it a pilot with an explicit cutlist.
Legal: We'll need to review the invite-while-not-SSO approach; shouldn't be a blocker for pilot but need language. Can review same-day if we get the doc.
Kartik (Infra): Breakdown: full SAML = ~4 dev-weeks (infra+app). Minimal invite workaround + tenant routing = ~6 dev-days. We can also split SSO into "auth core" (2w) + "enterprise SAML" (2w) if we want phased dev.
Anya (PM): Decision: cut full SSO to v1. move ahead with invite-only pilot + tenant routing in MVP. We keep a phased SSO plan on the roadmap. I'll update release notes + customer comms.
Mike (Eng Lead): I'll create a cutlist PR with the exact endpoints/features removed from MVP by EOD.
Jill (UX): I'll update onboarding mocks for invite flow and admin console. target: Thu afternoon.
Sales: I'll draft the pilot scope + wording for Acme and ask for NDA/MSA.
Legal: We'll prioritize review for the pilot wording; expect response by 3pm.
Anya (PM): Action items: Mike PR by EOD, Jill mocks by Thu, Sales pilot note by tomorrow, Legal review by 3pm. Rolling launch date stays Nov 12 for MVP. :thumbsup:
Mike (Eng Lead): PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/platform/pull/847 — cutlist + feature flags added. please review.
deploy-bot: Kanban: release-plan updated — canary window scheduled Nov 10-11, prod roll Nov 12.
Anya (PM): Thanks all. I'll update the roadmap doc and post a short note to the Acme channel outlining pilot constraints and next steps.
Sales: Ping me if you want me to join the customer call tomorrow.
Mike (Eng Lead): quick note — we should include a telemetry check for tenant routing: add an alert if route mismatch >0.5% during canary.
Kartik (Infra): Added alert suggestion to infra board.
Anya (PM): OK closing here. will post a follow-up thread with the updated milestone tracker and CR/PR links.
